messages.author: 26a87d764f5562dc
messages.subject: Can't get nimSeq to work
parts:
Hello,

This may be a silly question, but I can't seem to figure this out. I have the following inside a custom update:

xpoints <- nimSeq(from=1,to=10,by=1)

This works in R, but when I compile, I get the error:

Error: In sizeColonOperator: Problem determining size for : without two arguments.
 This occurred for: :(1,10,1,0)
 This was part of the call:  xpoints <- :(1,10,1,0)

Thanks,

Ben

messages.author: dd632bd3bbcdd7e9
messages.subject: Re: Can't get nimSeq to work
parts:
On first glance this looks like a bug.  It will take more time to see what's going and how it got around our test suite.

For this case, you can write
xpoints <- 1:10

For a more general case, I guess some workarounds are

    ans <- numeric(10)
    for(i in 1:10)
      ans[i] <- i*1

or

    ans <- (1:10) * .1 # e.g. for by = 0.1

Thanks for the report.

-Perry
